ceo_directive: Search incompleteness is impossible to hide. BALANCE_EXHAUSTED must propagate to SEARCH_COMPLETENESS=INCOMPLETE. Must never become NO_PRIOR_ART_FOUND.

PATENT_SEARCH_COMPLETE.definition: All discovery sources attempted, all family members identified, all claims retrieved, all passages charted

PATENT_SEARCH_PARTIAL.definition: Some sources attempted, some family members identified, some claims retrieved
PATENT_SEARCH_PARTIAL.blocks: LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY (cannot be buyer-ready with partial search)

PATENT_SEARCH_BLOCKED.mandatory_propagation: BALANCE_EXHAUSTED → SEARCH_COMPLETENESS=BLOCKED → final_status cannot be WOULD_CONSIDER or BUYER_READY

forbidden_transitions: PATENT_SEARCH_BLOCKED → NO_PRIOR_ART_FOUND (forbidden: absence of evidence != evidence of absence)
PATENT_SEARCH_PARTIAL → 102_PROVEN (forbidden: partial search cannot prove 102 globally)
PATENT_SEARCH_BLOCKED → 103_NON_OBVIOUS (forbidden: cannot infer non-obviousness from incomplete search)
current_state: PATENT_SEARCH_BLOCKED (PatSnap BALANCE_EXHAUSTED, EPO OPS/USPTO/Lens not configured)
